name: Punjab National Bank
business_summary: India's second-largest public-sector bank by business (government 70.08%), Rs11-12 lakh cr advances and Rs16-17 lakh cr deposits (model est.), ~50% of loans repo/EBLR-linked. Q2 FY27: PAT Rs5,532cr (+13% y/y), NII Rs11,601cr (+11%), NIM above guidance, provisions lower, slippages up from June quarter. Management expects 7-9bp NIM expansion in Q3 after the 2026-10-07 repo hike and targets Rs6,000cr quarterly profit. Debut dollar bond planned but deferred (early 2027). Stock Rs125.8, P/E 6.9x, P/B 0.95x, +12% in a month, +8% on results day.

exposures.mechanism: Asset-sensitive: ~50% of Rs11-12 lakh cr advances are EBLR/repo-linked (model est.) => 25bp = ~Rs1,400cr/yr; deposit repricing gives back about half over 6-12 months; management guides NIM +7-9bp in Q3 (~Rs1,400cr annualised on ~Rs18 lakh cr assets = ~5% of PBT ~Rs29,000cr). Net +2.5% PBT x persistence 0.5 ~ +1.2, then offset by slower growth/treasury losses (see G-sec) => +1. Wide range because stock reaction to hikes depends on growth fears.

evidence.note: PNB expects 7-9bp NIM expansion in Q3 after the repo hike (ET BFSI 2026-10-19)
PNB, BoB, Indian Bank, UCO raise repo-linked lending rates after hike (Moneycontrol 2026-10-08)
RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening', first hike in ~4 years (The Hindu 2026-10-07; Business Standard 2026-10-14: near-term cuts off the table)
